title: Are most of you already familiar with Hermetic philosophy?
content: The main idea is that the All is mind and the universe is mental. We are all microcosms of the macrocosm and vice versa… This is then further broken down into seven principles: Mentalism Correspondence (as above so below, as below so above, as within so without, as without so within) Vibration Polarity Rhythm Cause and Effect Gender
